content: The provided text is a detailed list of drug interactions involving fosaprepitant and various other medications, primarily mediated through the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. 1. Fosaprepitant can increase the levels or effects of mestranol by influencing its metabolism through the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Caution and monitoring are advised. 2. Fosaprepitant increases the levels or effects of methadone by altering its metabolism via CYP3A4. Close monitoring is recommended. 3. Fosaprepitant enhances the levels or effects of methylprednisolone by affecting its metabolism through CYP3A4. Conversely, methylprednisolone decreases the levels or effects of fosaprepitant. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 4. Metronidazole increases the levels or effects of fosaprepitant by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is advised. 5. Vaginal miconazole increases the levels or effects of fosaprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are required. 6. Fosaprepitant raises the levels or effects of midazolam by altering its metabolism via CYP3A4. Monitoring is recommended. 7. Fosaprepitant increases the levels or effects of mifepristone by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 8. Mitotane decreases fosaprepitant levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Mitotane is a strong inducer of CYP3A4, and dosage adjustments for co-administered CYP3A4 substrates may be required. 9. Fosaprepitant increases the levels or effects of naldemedine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring for adverse effects is recommended, especially when co-administered with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. 10. Fosaprepitant increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir, and nelfinavir reciprocally increases fosaprepitant levels by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 11. Nevirapine decreases fosaprepitant levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is necessary. 12. Fosaprepitant increases the levels or effects of nicardipine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is recommended. 13. Nifedipine increases fosaprepitant levels by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are required. 14. Fosaprepitant raises the levels or effects of nilotinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is advised. 15. Fosaprepitant increases the levels or effects of nisoldipine by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 16. Fosaprepitant enhances the levels or effects of norgestrel by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors may further increase systemic norgestrel concentrations, raising the risk of adverse effects. 17. Fosaprepitant decreases the levels or effects of oliceridine by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. If co-administration is necessary, less frequent oliceridine dosing may be required. Close monitoring for respiratory depression and sedation is essential, and dosage adjustments should be made accordingly. 18. Oxcarbazepine reduces fosaprepitant levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is recommended. 19. Fosaprepitant increases the levels or effects of palbociclib by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is necessary. 20. Fosaprepitant raises the levels or effects of palovarotene by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors should be avoided. If unavoidable, the palovarotene dose should be reduced by 50%. 21. Pentobarbital decreases fosaprepitant levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is advised. 22. Phenobarbital reduces fosaprepitant levels by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 23. Phenytoin decreases fosaprepitant levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is recommended. 24. Posaconazole increases fosaprepitant levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is advised. 25. Fosaprepitant enhances the levels or effects of prednisolone by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Conversely, prednisolone decreases fosaprepitant levels. Monitoring is necessary. 26. Fosaprepitant increases the levels or effects of prednisone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is recommended. 27. Primidone reduces fosaprepitant levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is necessary. 28. Fosaprepitant raises the levels or effects of quetiapine by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is advised. 29. Fosaprepitant increases the levels or effects of quinidine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is necessary. 30. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases fosaprepitant levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is recommended. 31. Fosaprepitant enhances the levels or effects of repaglinide by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is necessary. 32. Rifapentine decreases fosaprepitant levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is advised. 33. Fosaprepitant raises the levels or effects of rimegepant by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Repeating the rimegepant dose within 48 hours should be avoided if co-administered with a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor. 34. Fosaprepitant increases the levels or effects of ritonavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is necessary. 35. Fosaprepitant enhances the levels or effects of romidepsin by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is recommended. 36. Rucaparib increases fosaprepitant levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Dosage adjustments for CYP3A4 substrates may be required. 37. Rufinamide decreases fosaprepitant levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is necessary. 38. Fosaprepitant raises the levels or effects of ruxolitinib (both systemic and topical) by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is advised. 39. Fosaprepitant increases seladelpar levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution is advised in poor CYP2C9 metabolizers co-administered with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 40. Fosaprepitant enhances the levels or effects of sildenafil by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is necessary. 41. Fosaprepitant raises the levels or effects of solifenacin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is recommended. 42. Fosaprepitant increases the levels or effects of sonidegib by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors should be avoided. If unavoidable, the duration of moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor use should be limited to less than 14 days, with close monitoring for musculoskeletal adverse reactions. 43. Stiripentol, a CYP3A4 inhibitor and inducer, affects fosaprepitant metabolism. Monitoring for increased or decreased effects of CYP3A4 substrates is necessary, and dosage adjustments may be required. 44. Fosaprepitant raises the levels or effects of sufentanil SL by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration with CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase sufentanil plasma concentrations, potentially leading to fatal respiratory depression. 45. Fosaprepitant enhances the levels or effects of sunitinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is necessary. 46. Fosaprepitant increases the levels or effects of suvorexant by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. The starting dose of suvorexant should be reduced to 5 mg if co-administered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. 47. Fosaprepitant raises the levels or effects of tacrolimus by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is recommended. 48. Fosaprepitant enhances the levels or effects of tadalafil by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is necessary. 49. Fosaprepitant increases tamsulosin levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Dose reduction may be required for co-administered drugs predominantly metabolized by CYP3A4. 50. Tazemetostat decreases fosaprepitant levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is advised. 51. Tecovirimat reduces fosaprepitant levels by weakly inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring for effectiveness of sensitive CYP3A4 substrates is necessary. 52. Fosaprepitant raises the levels or effects of temsirolimus by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is recommended. 53. Fosaprepitant increases the levels or effects of tezacaftor by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Dosage adjustments for tezacaftor may be required when co-administered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. 54. Fosaprepitant enhances the levels or effects of theophylline by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is necessary. 55. Fosaprepitant decreases the levels or effects of tinidazole by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is recommended. 56. Fosaprepitant raises the levels or effects of tipranavir by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is necessary. 57. Fosaprepitant increases tofacitinib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. No specific dose adjustment is recommended with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors, but dose reduction is necessary if co-administered with both moderate CYP3A4 and potent CYP2C19 inhibitors. 58. Fosaprepitant enhances the levels or effects of tolterodine by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is advised. 59. Topiramate decreases fosaprepitant levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is necessary. 60. Fosaprepitant raises the levels or effects of trabectedin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is recommended. 61. Fosaprepitant increases trazodone levels by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is necessary. 62. Fosaprepitant enhances the levels or effects of triamcinolone acetonide injectable suspension by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is recommended. 63. Fosaprepitant raises the levels or effects of triazolam by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is necessary. 64. Fosaprepitant decreases the levels or effects of ubrogepant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Dose adjustment is recommended when co-administered with moderate or weak CYP3A4 inducers. 65. Fosaprepitant increases the levels or effects of vardenafil by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Dose reduction may be necessary when co-administered with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 66. Fosaprepitant raises the levels or effects of verapamil by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is recommended. 67. Fosaprepitant enhances the levels or effects of voclosporin by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is necessary. 68. Voriconazole increases fosaprepitant levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is advised. 69. Fosaprepitant decreases warfarin levels by affecting CYP2C9/10 metabolism. INR monitoring is recommended, particularly 7–10 days after fosaprepitant administration during chemotherapy cycles. 70. Zafirlukast increases fosaprepitant levels by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is necessary. 71. Fosaprepitant raises the levels or effects of zanubrutinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Dose reduction is recommended when co-administered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. After discontinuing the inhibitor, the previous zanubrutinib dose should be resumed. 72. Acetazolamide increases fosaprepitant levels by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 73. Fosaprepitant raises the levels or effects of alfentanil by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 74. Fosaprepitant enhances the levels or effects of alfuzosin by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 75. Fosaprepitant increases the levels or effects of alosetron by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 76. Fosaprepitant raises the levels or effects of amlodipine by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 77. Amobarbital decreases fosaprepitant levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 78. Anastrozole increases fosaprepitant levels by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 79. Fosaprepitant enhances the levels or effects of armodafinil by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitoring is necessary.
